headlines.description: — Paul Skenes allowed one run and struck out eight in seven innings and the Pittsburgh Pirates defeated the Cleveland Guardians 7-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Skenes strikes out 8 in 7 innings as Pirates roll to 7-1 win over Guardians

headlines.description: — Nico Hoerner had four hits to tie a career high, Matthew Boyd gave up three hits and one run in six sharp innings to win his fourth straight start, and the Chicago Cubs beat the Minnesota Twins 6-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Cubs beat the Twins 6-2 as Nico Hoerner ties a career high with 4 hits

events.name: New York Mets at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Kyle Schwarber hit his major league-leading 33rd home run, fellow All-Star Jesús Luzardo allowed two hits in five strong innings and the Philadelphia Phillies defeated the New York Mets 6-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schwarber, Turner and Luzardo lead the Phillies to a 6-1 victory over the Mets

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Shane Bieber and three relievers combined on a four-hitter, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. reached base three times and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the White Sox 1-0 on Saturday to snap Chicago’s four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shane Bieber pitches Blue Jays past White Sox 1-0 to snap Chicago's winning streak at 4

headlines.description: — TJ Rumfield had a two-run homer during a four-hit game and Tomoyuki Sugano threw efficiently into the seventh in his return from the injured...
headlines.shortLinkText: Rumfield erupts for 4 hits, Sugano efficient in return from injured list as Rockies beat Reds 10-3

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Wilyer Abreu hit two home runs – the second a go-ahead, two-run shot in the seventh inning that gave him four homers in two games — and the Boston Red Sox rallied for a 7-6 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Saturday to extend their winning streak...
headlines.shortLinkText: Make it a dozen: Red Sox rally for 7-6 victory over Rays for 12th straight win

headlines.description: — Brandon Nimmo's two-run single in the sixth inning gave Texas the lead as the Rangers rallied from an early deficit to beat the Atlanta Braves 7-6 on Saturday in a matchup of...
headlines.shortLinkText: Nimmo delivers go-ahead, 2-run single in 6th inning and drives in 3 as Rangers edge Braves 7-6

headlines.description: — Gunnar Henderson scored the tiebreaking run from second base on Tyler O’Neill’s infield single with two outs in the 11th inning, and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Houston Astros 4-2 on Saturday for their sixth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Orioles outlast Astros 4-2 in 11 innings for 6th consecutive victory

headlines.description: — Jackson Chourio put Milwaukee ahead with a two-run single in a four-run sixth inning that sent the Brewers past the skidding Miami Marlins 8-6 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers overcome early deficit in 8-6 victory over skidding Marlins

events.name: San Diego Padres at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Salvador Perez and Lane Thomas homered to help the Kansas City Royals beat the San Diego Padres 6-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Salvador Perez and Lane Thomas hit 2-run HRs, Royals beat Padres 6-1

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Nolan Arenado had a two-run double as he closes on 2,000 career hits, Brandon Pfaadt had another good day on the mound since returning from the minors and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the St. Louis Cardinals 5-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nolan Arenado closes in on 2,000 career hits, Diamondbacks top the Cardinals 5-3

headlines.shortLinkText: Bazzana hits 2-run homer in 9th to rally Guardians to 5-3 victory over Pirates

San Francisco Giants at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Julio Rodríguez hit a walk-off sacrifice fly and Cole Young added a three-run home run to help the Mariners beat the San Francisco Giants 4-3 in 10 innings on Saturday night, Seattle's first win since the All-Star break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodríguez’s walk-off sacrifice fly propels Mariners to 4-3 win against Giants in 10 innings

headlines.shortLinkText: A's rebound and rout Nationals 15-1 to stop 10-game skid as Ginn takes no-hitter into 7th inning

events.name: Detroit Tigers at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Tarik Skubal pitched seven dominant innings, Spencer Torkelson homered twice and drove in four runs, and the Detroit Tigers cruised to a 7-0 win over the Los Angeles Angels on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Skubal strikes out 9 in 7 innings and Torkelson homers twice in Tigers' 7-0 win over Angels
